In this role, you will be part of a close-knit and hardworking team. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all tasks are carried out as efficiently as possible so that the workday can be completed together.

Once the crates are filled, you will place them on a conveyor belt, where they are automatically transported to the next department. You will use a handheld scanner in combination with a voice-picking system. For this position, it’s important that you have basic computer skills, as you will also need to process certain warehouse tasks in the system. During a comprehensive training session on your first working day, you will learn how to use this system.

Most of your work will take place in the warehouse, where you will collect products. Some of these products are stored in refrigerated or freezer areas. You will be provided with a warm jacket for working in these areas. After collecting the required products, you will return to the main warehouse.

- Minimum of vmbo-level work and thinking skills

jobs.description:
As a Precision Mechanical Finishing Operator, you will be responsible for the final finishing of CNC-produced plastic components. You will inspect, deburr, tap, ream, and clean parts using the available tools and equipment, ensuring that the finished products meet customer specifications and quality standards.

Your tasks include:

- Inspecting CNC-produced plastic components.
- Deburring, tapping, reaming, and cleaning finished parts.
- Checking products against technical drawings and customer specifications.
- Ensuring the quality and accuracy of the finished product.
- Identifying and reporting deviations or quality issues.
- Working with various tools and equipment in a safe and accurate manner.
- Suggesting improvements to production and finishing processes.
- Following safety instructions and using personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
- Keeping the workplace clean, organized, and safe.

You will be the final link between production and the customer, making sure every component meets the required specifications before delivery.

You will work full-time in a day shift from Monday to friday 07:00 to 16:00.

- Minimum B2 level of English and/or B2–C1 level of Dutch.
- MBO-level thinking and working ability.
- Technical insight and ability to read technical drawings.
- Experience in a similar technical or production role.
- Accurate, careful, and quality-focused way of working.
- Able to work independently as well as effectively within a team.
- Proactive, flexible, and stress-resistant attitude.
- Willingness to work with various tools and machines.
- Good attention to detail when inspecting and finishing products.
- Ability to assess whether finished products meet customer specifications.
- Willingness to follow safety procedures and use PPE when required.
- Physically able to perform tasks involving lifting, bending, and reaching.

As a logistics employee nightshifts, you help with loading and unloading trucks. This means moving roll containers that can weigh up to 150 kilos. No problem for you! Additionally, you are available for at least three evenings/nights and:

What will you do
PostNL Tiel is one of PostNL's crossdock locations. Here, roll containers full of packages are transferred to be sent to the correct destination with a different driver. How does this work? Trucks arrive with, for example, three roll containers for the Tilburg region and three for the Breda region. Each region is collected separately so that a full truck can drive to Tilburg and another to Breda. This saves unnecessary trips across the country for just a few roll containers. As a logistics employee nightshifts, you unload the trucks and place the roll containers in the right sections. Is there an empty truck that needs to be filled? You make sure the correct roll containers are loaded. Then you neatly put the roll containers back into the truck.

- Flexible working hours in rotation from 09:00 PM to 05:30 AM, 10:00 PM to 06:00 AM, 00:30 AM to 09:00 AM and 01:30 AM to 10:00 AM.
- Working days Monday through Friday and Sunday in rotation.
